title: Gated D Latch
statement: Implement a gated D latch that transparently passes the input when enable is high and holds the value when enable is low. The latch must be level-sensitive, not edge-triggered, and must capture the input immediately while enabled. This is a basic storage element used in asynchronous design.
module_signature: module gated_d_latch(input en, input d, output reg q);
behavior: When en is 1, q follows d continuously.
When en is 0, q retains its last value.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not infer an edge-triggered flip-flop or use clk signals.
hint: Use transparent latch behavior in a combinational feedback loop.
